en.title: LEXANDRO Portfolio
en.lead: My own portfolio: one design system with three themes, a live sandbox and a brief builder, in four languages.

sections.title: the idea
body: One site that shows the whole way I work: design, code and automation, end to end.
Case pages are built from content files, so a new project goes live without touching the code.

sections.title: design system
body: Colour, type, spacing and motion are tokens. The dark, neon and light themes change only token values, the components stay the same.
In the sandbox a visitor changes radius, density, accent, font and theme and watches a small booking site rebuild itself.

sections.title: build
body: Next.js with a static export on GitHub Pages, English, Russian, Chinese and Japanese versions, and a brief builder that prepares a message for Telegram or email.
A private admin panel edits cases, screenshots and translations and publishes them with one commit.
